name: PDS Particles & Models Kit
summary: PDS particle/model library with three top-level groups: particles, model presets and Log.
install: Import into ServerStorage, inspect the PDS Particle Pack for BSED:R and PDS Models Pack for BSED:R groups, then copy the desired effect or model into Workspace. Keep required attachments, emitter parents and preset scripts together. Review each sample script before enabling it.
limits: Uses the owner-supplied preview image as requested. No new particle simulation, per-effect gallery or motion/playback verification was performed. Original binary contains 34 ParticleEmitters and four scripts; the large hierarchy also includes model/geometry samples.
credit: Embedded labels credit Quantack, Antimatter & B1GPIG and identify kit version 2.0.0. Labels state most particle artwork is not owned by the kit authors and condition sharing on the kit having been released; original notices remain in the native file. Operator supplied this kit for publication; underlying third-party artwork is not relicensed by this repository.
verification: Native binary hierarchy and scripts inspected. Reused owner-supplied image as explicitly requested. No new effect captures, simulation or per-effect verification.
